title: Claude Hopkins's underrated musicianship; interpretation
summary: Dance says Hopkins never got his due. Thomas praises Hopkins and says music is interpretation, crediting his teachers with basic trumpet ideas.

story.theme_name: Remembering the early trumpeters and their styles
story.community_name: Trumpeters I admired: rating the horn players

blocks.x: Hop never really has had the credit he should have had, you know. Not to my mind.
No, we're getting finished. No, but I mean as a band leader, everybody knows ...
Well, wonderful. Phil Hopkins is one of the great musicians.
But I mean when you think of Lunskine and Erskin know Hawkins and these people, people all kind about them but they don't really remember Claude Hopkins.

But, interpretation, her interpretation runs this way and mine runs this way so, pardon me, within that conversation interpretation it comes out good music. ...
